name: deployment-activity
goal: Show concurrent dev, stage, preprod and prod deployments in a top-right activity panel with shared progress and detail components.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Specified top-right activity, shared components, host-wide background jobs, per-target ordering, captured source proof and atomic receipts before implementation.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Implemented host-wide per-target queues, isolated captured sources, atomic receipts, activity light and shared deployment progress/details. Local provider tests and affected browser flows pass.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Baseline UI and concurrency failures reproduced before product changes. Focused backend 30/30, permissions 6/6, shared impact 13/13, component/store 5/5 and browser 8/8 pass; fresh screenshots inspected.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
steps.evidence: Every required verification stage passed: initial root stages through Planning; complete Desktop 874 tests and 178 acceptance cases, Collaboration, Hub, Remote and Relay.
